name: Ship classification
access: Surveyors attend construction and periodic surveys.
publication: Class status public; survey reports confidential.
ai_analogue: An owner-paid assurance regime that has survived for 260 years through mutual recognition, transfer-of-class rules, and flag-state delegation, with repeated crises from class shopping.

milestones.event: Lloyd's Register begins as an underwriters' register of ship condition.
IACS founded to harmonize class societies.
Erika sinks after changing class; 2002 Prestige sinks.
EU Regulation 391/2009 sets recognition and independence rules for classification societies acting for flag states.
